notes: Checked: main header nav, footer nav ('Vous inspirer' block links 'Nos nouveautes'), homepage flight-data links, and the category sitemap. Found a genuine site-wide New Arrivals hub 'Nos nouveautes' (https://www.castorama.fr/nos-nouveautes/cat_id_0008774.cat), a real PLP (product tiles with 'Nouveau' badges, own filter/sort UI, rendered '1 328 produits' header) with a site-exposed category facet panel showing 14 genuine department children (each is a distinct '-dyn.cat' URL fetched directly; its own results header matched the parent hub's facet-panel counts exactly for the top 5 checked live: sdb 417, electricite 269, jardin 158, luminaire 132, chauffage 102 - confirming these are real site-defined sub-listings, not generic facet reruns; leaf counts sum to 1344 vs parent 1328, the small variance being normal live-inventory drift / minor department overlap between fetches, not a structural mismatch). No 'New Collection'-style page needed the ambiguous-collection judgment call - 'Nos nouveautes' and its children are unambiguous, literal new-arrivals listings (not lookbooks or campaigns). No other new-arrivals-labelled hub ('Nouveautes', 'Nouveaux produits', 'Just In') found elsewhere on the site.
